nodes.label: Explicit joint-effort actuation breaks pi_base gait
nodes.rationale: pi_base walked under every implicit drive tested but under no explicit actuator (incl. IdealPD) at any gain/rate; pointed at the explicit-effort path, later fixed by PhysX enable_external_forces_every_iteration

nodes.label: PhysX enable_external_forces_every_iteration fix
nodes.rationale: Explicit efforts barely act under Isaac Lab default TGS setting; user accepted switching to PhysX position drive if needed

nodes.label: S0a run 1 standing optimum (failure)
nodes.rationale: PPO at LR 1e-4, std 0.07 never escaped the standing optimum inherited under the solver artefact

nodes.label: S0a run 2 termination (fall) exploit
nodes.rationale: Every surviving behaviour had negative per-step reward while a fall cost -5 once; ending the episode was cheapest, found in 40 iterations

nodes.label: cpg_coxa_contact signed stroke term
nodes.rationale: abs(qdot) version paid ~92 % of pi_base coxa reward for back-and-forth motion, not net stroke

nodes.label: cpg_z_target toe swing kernel
nodes.rationale: Sigma tightened 2 -> 1 cm in run 4 so stutter micro-lifts earn nothing; step height 3.8 -> 4 cm in S1 pilot 3

nodes.label: eval_s0 clearance metric correction (swings > 5 mm)
nodes.rationale: eval_s0 averaged every lift-off apex incl. sub-5 mm stutter micro-lifts; clearance gate reinterpreted with user since pi_base high-stepping came from tibia-origin target

nodes.label: Right-side crutch leg imbalance
nodes.rationale: pi_base barely stepped RM/RB legs (0.10-0.11 swings/s); inherited through warm starts; resolved in S0a run 4

nodes.label: Policy barely responds to slow commands
nodes.rationale: Zero-init twist_cmd columns learned against command-independent terms several times larger; below the 0.16 m/s clock knee only stride sets speed. Fix: per-step tracking weight x3

nodes.label: Per-step velocity tracking reward (x30)
nodes.rationale: Cycle-averaged tracking (run 3) grew within-stride surge; reverted to per-step, weighted so tracking dominates

nodes.label: Tucked right-back leg standing local optimum
nodes.rationale: No small change of the tucked leg improves load-share/contact terms until foot reaches ground; survived clip penalty, standing pose term, 50 % standing share

nodes.label: standing_pose penalty
nodes.rationale: Dense per-joint pull home to escape tucked local optimum; weight -1 -> -3

nodes.label: action_beyond_clip penalty
nodes.rationale: Right-back coxa requested -69 deg, 14 deg past the stop; weight -1 -> -10

nodes.label: Standing settle window (run 10)
nodes.rationale: First standing fix that moved right-back contact 0.05 -> 0.57

nodes.label: Terrain curriculum levels 0-14 + stairs (held-out 15-20)
nodes.rationale: Swing height ~3.8 cm is the binding limit; harder geometry would make blind arms fail geometrically and blur the friction/compliance comparison (v7 5.4)

nodes.label: coxa_stroke_weight scaled by rest reach (lopsided turning fix)
nodes.rationale: Coxa stroke term was farmable by tucked toes (small |r|); weighting by |r_xy|/rest reach removed spin exploit

nodes.label: Left-right mirror data augmentation
nodes.rationale: Helped every asymmetric measure (turning, per-leg)

nodes.label: Blind from-scratch control arm
nodes.rationale: Passed all S0b gates at 0.30x warm-start budget, so warm start and KL anchor dropped for every arm

nodes.label: Rest-reach measured in USD zero pose bug
nodes.rationale: load_managers measured reach before rest pose written; fix writes rest pose and steps physics once

nodes.label: Feet migrated under the hips (gait geometry)
nodes.rationale: Static joint torque scales with horizontal joint-to-foot distance, so pulling feet under hips is cheaper; narrows support

nodes.label: swing_radial_motion reward
nodes.rationale: Mid-air toe in/out motion (tibia unfold) penalised to get coordinated lift; fine-tuning converged pi_S0 failed even at 5x, required from-scratch run
